data.why: dash_baseline.py reads only cached parquets already committed under data/real, data/fields and data/counties, plus fields.yml; nothing needs to be supplied from prep/.

goals: compare how well NDVI and weather features predict county corn yield across Missouri (Ridge vs GBR, R2/RMSE)
find which growing-season feature (July NDVI, July tmax, drought flag) drives yield variance
drill into a specific county's NDVI time series and yield history across 2001-2023
check whether a known drought year (2012, 2022) shows up cleanly in the statewide trend
inspect a monitored field's latest NDVI/SAR tile and its z-score against its own historical baseline to flag crop stress
see whether per-county live Sentinel NDVI/SAR tracks the historical MODIS baseline for that county

review.summary: This is a careful, well-evidenced tree of what the baseline dashboard actually does: regional yield survey, county drill-down, static weather correlations, and field and county Sentinel monitoring. It is also honest that the README's modelling results (Ridge vs GBR, feature importance) and the z-score stress flag never appear in the interface. It needs small fixes before filing: correct the t10 NDVI range, firm up the one-action correlation phase and give it a feature, add the blocked stress-flag task, and add the replay's caveats to the features.
